why_relevant: Company directory with vacancy, salary and contact aggregation per employer; primarily an actor-map/pointer resource for identifying fintech and payment-tech employers we have not yet enumerated, then following them onto Djinni/DOU.

Parent outlet of Ekonomichna Pravda; carries the politically-salient bank governance stories (regulator vs. government fights over who chairs a state bank's supervisory board) that drive many leadership changes.

source_name: NV.ua topic tag pages (e.g. НБУ tag)
why_relevant: Tag archives give a stable, paginated entry point into all NV coverage of a given institution, which is a cheaper crawl surface than the main feed for backfilling appointment history.

Dedicated banking news sub-section with a steady flow of regulator-driven personnel stories (e.g. NBU ordering the dismissal of Sens Bank's supervisory-board chair). Structured URL path makes it a clean crawl target for the banking vertical only.

source_name: LIGA File (file.liga.net) — person dossiers / biographical database
why_relevant: Structured dossier database of Ukrainian public and business figures with photo, biography and career track. This is the highest-value pointer in this cell: it converts a name found in an appointment headline into a career timeline and prior employer set, and can be used to build the A5 actor map for Ukrainian banking executives.

Wire-style, dated, one-fact-per-item coverage of banking and regulator personnel: NBU approving a CEO candidacy, NBU department director appointments, regulator ordering a state company to oust its CEO. Numeric sequential news IDs make the economic feed straightforward to enumerate and backfill.

Carries the internationally-salient subset of Ukrainian banking appointments (PrivatBank CEO election, NBU approval of Ukreximbank CEO), useful as an English-language cross-check and for items that matter to foreign counterparties.

State news agency tag archive aggregating banking news chronologically with deep pagination (46+ pages observed), giving a broad, low-noise-per-page backfill surface for institutional and personnel news. Agency style means appointments are reported plainly and dated.

The densest single feed of Ukrainian bank personnel news found in this cell: board-chair changes at Credit Agricole Bank, PrivatBank, Raiffeisen, PINBank chair resignation, NBU department-head appointments, supervisory-board joiners at Sens Bank. Niche financial trade outlet, so signal-to-noise is far better than general media.

A dossier rubric on a banking-specialist outlet is the natural place where executive career histories and bank ownership/management profiles are compiled — a second enrichment layer alongside LIGA File, but banking-native.

source_subtype: business media vertical of a general news portal
why_relevant: Covers internal organizational actions that rarely reach the wires — e.g. Sens Bank suspending its financial-monitoring director and cutting system access. That level of below-board personnel detail is exactly the A5 signal that companies never announce.

Analytical weekly that reports on the regulatory process behind a dismissal before it happens — e.g. that the NBU would decide the following week whether Stupak may remain Sense Bank board chair, tied to a collateral scandal. Gives forward-looking lead time on leadership changes rather than after-the-fact confirmation.

source_subtype: general/political news media with economics desk
why_relevant: Reports Cabinet-level decisions terminating state-bank supervisory-board mandates with attribution to the minister announcing them — often the fastest source for government-side (as opposed to bank-side) personnel decisions.
Broadcaster site that carried the government dismissal of the Sens Bank supervisory-board chair; low unique value but broad, and occasionally publishes video/quote material absent from text outlets.

Financial portal with per-bank company pages carrying a dedicated news stream (/ua/company/<bank-slug>/news/). Because the URL pattern is per-institution, it is an efficient pointer for building bank-scoped monitoring including management news, without crawling the whole site.

Delo.ua with the Top-100 project runs a 'best CFOs of Ukraine' / financial-sector leaders rating covering banks, insurers, MFIs, payment systems and crypto platforms. Ratings of named executives per company are a periodic structured roster of who currently sits in senior finance roles — useful as a baseline against which appointment news is diffed.

source_name: DOU.ua forums — fintech/banking IT management discussions
why_relevant: Ukrainian IT community platform whose threads discuss management of bank/fintech tech projects from the inside. Reveals-indirectly category: practitioners name teams, reorganizations and hiring conditions that neither banks nor business media publish. Noisy and unverified, but a leading indicator for org changes below board level.

Maintained succession lists (e.g. 'Список голів Національного банку України') and executive biographies give a free, structured historical baseline of tenure start/end dates, and their reference sections point back to the original media announcements — a cheap way to bootstrap the A5 historical timeline before live monitoring starts.

Ranking project on Ukrainian banks whose analytical write-ups typically quote named board members by title, providing periodic corroboration of who holds which role and how banks describe their own org priorities.
Machine-readable firehose of the highest-value cell source; removes need for HTML scraping and gives near-real-time detection of personnel items.

Recurring data-journalism series on state-bank top-management remuneration and board composition; an indirect but quantified read on headcount, board size and turnover at Oschadbank/Ukrgasbank/PrivatBank/Sens Bank.

source_name: PaySpace Magazine Awards (PSM Awards) — щорічна фінтех-премія
why_relevant: Annual awards lists name companies AND individual executives/experts recognised by the payments community — a cheap annual snapshot of who currently holds which senior role across Ukrainian fintech/payments, and a seed list for actor-map expansion.

High-volume finance portal with a dedicated banks/insurance news rubric; publishes supervisory-board and management-board appointments, temporary administrations, and restructurings (e.g. new independent supervisory board member at Sens Bank; NABU president appointment; temporary administration at RVS Bank). Also aggregates other outlets, so it doubles as a pointer.

source_name: Мінфін — сторінки новин по компанії (per-bank news feeds)
why_relevant: Per-institution news pages give an entity-keyed view: point the collector at the ~20 banks/PSPs in scope and get an institution-scoped stream instead of filtering the whole portal. Ideal for org-change tracking per actor.

Banking-only trade portal that covers appointments down to supervisory-board and department level (e.g. Crédit Agricole Bank supervisory board chair) and runs people-centric projects such as 'ТОП-30 інфлюенсерів фінсектору України' — a ready-made actor map of the Ukrainian financial sector.

Niche economics/finance outlet with a dedicated banks feed and a track record of covering NBU personnel policy explicitly (e.g. interview-derived item 'Пишний — про кадрову політику: зміни будуть, але не революційні'). Low-volume but high specificity for regulator and state-bank staffing.

source_name: Bankchart.com.ua — банківський порівняльний портал і рейтинги
why_relevant: Product-comparison and bank-rating portal (assets, liabilities, capital, profit; reviews of deposit/credit/card markets). Weak on named personnel but strong as a structural baseline: which institutions exist, their scale and product footprint — needed to weight the significance of an appointment or a branch/department restructuring.
